content: Language constructions here correspond to reduced caption representations which only record whether an object is described by shape (e.g., “square”), color (e.g., “red shape”) or color-shape combination (e.g., “red square”). So the statement “A square is red” and “A circle is blue” are considered the same, while “A shape is red” is different.
